raw_user_query: why do my legs start paining and burning when i run really fast for a long time, my brother said it's because of no oxygen reaching muscles, is that true?

orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Why do legs start paining and burning when running fast for a long time?
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
- When you run fast for a long time, your muscles need more energy.

- This energy comes from a process called respiration, which uses oxygen.

- If you run too fast, your body may not supply enough oxygen to your muscles.

- Without enough oxygen, your muscles start producing lactic acid, which can cause pain and a burning sensation.

- This is why you feel discomfort in your legs when you push yourself too hard while running.
